description: This file contains client-side JavaScript code for a web application, including functions for Markdown preview synchronization, Bootstrap tooltip initialization, alert message display, form change detection, external link decoration, and JSON data extraction.

methods.name: syncScrolling
methods.description: Synchronizes scrolling between a textarea/input and its Markdown preview.

methods.name: initTootips
methods.description: Initializes Bootstrap tooltips for elements with data-bs-toggle='tooltip'.

methods.name: alertMessage
methods.description: Creates and displays a Bootstrap-styled alert message in the DOM.

methods.name: decorateExternalLinks
methods.description: Adds an icon to external links that open in a new window.

methods.name: decodeHtml
methods.description: Decodes HTML entities into plain text.

methods.name: getJsonData
methods.description: Retrieves and parses JSON data embedded in an HTML element by ID.
